baseline.note: Stopped at the first balanced 100-cell factorial block by user request.

new_measurements.monolith_reference: Reuse checksum-frozen matching baseline cells; do not rerun.

implementation_changes: single-flight ARFF cache population to prevent concurrent duplicate parsing
validation dataset cache when training cache is enabled
removal of redundant full Instances copies before column filtering
optional RCL scale-out with ephemeral host ports and round-robin admission
responses: jobs reaching the scenario validation threshold
construction and IWSSR evaluations per second
CPU time, throttling and peak memory

analysis.pairing: Each optimized distributed cell is paired to the same seed/scenario/load monolith baseline cell.
analysis.interpretation: Exploratory effect sizes and uncertainty intervals; no confirmatory superiority claim from n=5.
analysis.success_gate: Proceed to a larger confirmatory campaign only if an optimized profile restores nonzero completion at loads 8 and 16 without worsening load-1/2 held-out macro-F1 by more than 0.01.
